mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, title, content, language, tags, summary, use_count AS useCount, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM code_snippet WHERE ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM code_snippet WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_snippet (user_id, title, content, language, tags, summary, use_count, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{language}, #{tags}, #{summary}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE code_snippet SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, language = #{language}, tags = #{tags}, summary = #{summary}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM code_snippet WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
